regime_context: The detector for China A-shares shows a clear leadership concentration in Gold Miners (score 2.105, durability 0.91, hurst 'trend') with a sharp drop to Industrial Metals (1.302) and a much weaker AI Compute leg. Crucially, the gate_helps flag is false — the absolute-trend discipline did not even reduce drawdown on this market's history (mean-reverting tape), and track_record dir_accuracy is 0.369, so I'm leaning low across the board.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Industrial Metals (512400.SS) closes the challenger margin against Gold Miners by more than half (score gap narrowing below ~0.4) while remaining eligible for 10 consecutive sessions — that would suggest a real resources handoff, not just a gold echo. Retire this watch if the gold-vs-metals score gap widens back above 1.0 or 512400.SS drops below trend eligibility.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Industrial Metals is the highest-scoring scorable theme (rank 2, score 1.302, eligible) offering a less reflexive way to express the broader resources/cyclicals leadership than the unscorable Gold Miners headline. Its durability bar (0.72) is comfortably positive and breadth (0.846) is the highest among eligible non-gold themes, suggesting participation is broad even though its hurst is 'mixed'. The rotation leader/challenger structure names it the challenger with a healthy 0.803 score margin behind gold — not a confirmed handoff, but a genuine second leg. With the trend gate unreliable in this market, this is a durability-anchored, not a momentum-anchored, lean.
evidence: ranks[1] Industrial Metals score 1.302, eligible true, durability_bar 0.72
durability_bar 0.72 > 0.5 and breadth 0.846 (highest among eligible non-gold)
rotation.challenger = cn_metals with margin 0.803 behind leader
theses.dissent: Hurst is 'mixed' not 'trend', and the broader rotation view is 'narrowing' (only 8 of 22 eligible). If the resources bid is essentially a gold-driven inflation/geopolitics story, Industrial Metals could be a late, weaker echo that mean-reverts hard when the macro narrative cools — which the unscheduled_share of 0.88 warns could happen abruptly on any headline reversal.

falsifier.text: 512400.SS lags the CSI 300 by 4% over the next 15 trading days

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is the only eligible theme carrying a crowding flag (crowded z 1.15, crowded true) among the top ranks, and its durability is unimpressive (0.52) with weak breadth (0.357) and 'mixed' hurst. Under the guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution, never a fade — so the honest lean here is avoid, not underweight. The macro backdrop is dominated by geopolitics and unscheduled surprises (0.88 share), not an obvious healthcare catalyst, so there is no reason to override the caution.
evidence: ranks[4] Innovative Pharma & CXO score 0.508, crowded true, crowding_z 1.15
theses.dissent: Crowding has no basket-level forward edge, and the theme is still ranked 5th with a positive score and eligible status. A healthcare policy catalyst or earnings beat could lift CXO names regardless of positioning texture — avoiding means forgoing that optionality.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ outperforms the CSI 300 by 5% over the next 20 trading days while crowded

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks rank 8th, score 0.228, and are flagged ineligible — they do not clear the absolute-trend gate. They are also crowded (z 1.62), which under guardrails is a down-size caution, never a short. With ineligibility plus crowding, the cleanest accountable directional expression is avoid rather than any underweight call. The durable strength is in eligible resources names, not financials value here.
evidence: durability_bar 0.69 but breadth 0.944 (broad but not trend-eligible)
theses.dissent: Breadth is very high (0.944) and durability is decent (0.69) — if a policy tailwind (e.g., SOE reform or rate relief) hits, banks could re-enter trend eligibility quickly. This is a positioning-texture lean, not a thesis that banks are structurally weak.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
